discrepancy_note: The CJ bonemap FILE maps LeftArm -> upperarm_L, LeftForeArm -> forearm_L, LeftHand -> hand_L. The CJ idle SCRIPT maps LeftShoulder -> upperarm_L, LeftArm -> forearm_L, LeftForeArm -> hand_L (shifted by one joint, as if the CJ shoulder bone were a clavicle). This file uses the BONEMAP FILE as primary because it matches the CJ deform-bone names; the shifted variant is listed separately and must be chosen explicitly for clips authored against the idle script. Do not mix the two maps in one clip.
spine_collapse_rule: CJ spine_1/spine_2 -> WH Spine and spine_3/spine_4/chest -> WH Chest. Multiple sources onto one target are sign-aligned and averaged in wh_show_retarget.retarget_pose(); intermediate spine motion is smoothed, not preserved 1:1.
finger_rule: CJ bonemap carries thumb + index only. In the canonical map those two fingers retarget; middle/ring/pinky hold rest. In a Mixamo49 target, map thumb/index as above and hold the other fingers at rest unless a fuller CJ finger map lands.
dropped_from_skeleton: Cape/collar bones and pegs (Cape Jones cape pieces) — routed to tools/cape/, not to WH skeleton joints.
Face/eye/lip joints and *_offset/*_null helpers (same drop rule as tools/retarget/tekken-bonemap.json).
CJ finger segments beyond thumb_1/index_1 in the bonemap (full CJ finger chains live in cape-rigging guides, not in this show map).
held_at_rest_on_wh_canonical: LeftShoulder/RightShoulder when the source has no shoulder bone (CMU source has no LeftShoulder/RightShoulder entry in the CJ bonemap; WH shoulders then hold rest unless the stance bake drives clavicles from the chest chain).
All Mixamo49 finger bones except thumb_1/index_1, all face bones, and any MB-Lab-only joints supplied via a caller target skeleton (see cape-rigging map note on the 71-joint list).
still_owed: Blender BVH/FBX -> GLB import/export run on a real show clip (blender_steps in wh_show_retarget.py).
EEVEE QA render front + side of a real retargeted WH character (the CI proof here is a stick-figure SVG).
A real CMU idle clip retarget (source clip bytes are not in this repo and are not copied here).
Full 71-joint MB-Lab target list as a checked-in skeleton (see cape-rigging map).
idle_script_shifted_variant_note: Use ONLY for clips authored against retarget_idle_cape.py's BONEMAP. Shoulder/arm/forearm are shifted by one joint relative to the primary map.
